artworks.title: Otus and Ephialtes Holding Mars (Ares) Captive
artworks.description: Flaxman/Piroli Iliad plate: the Aloadae bind Ares in a bronze jar for thirteen months — Homer's giant twins overpowering the war-god.

artworks.title: Diane entre deux géants (Diana Between Two Giants)
artworks.artist: Tapestry after a design by Toussaint Dubreuil
artworks.description: Chambord tapestry: Artemis flanked by Otus and Ephialtes — the Naxos trap where the goddess as a stag makes the brothers spear each other.

artworks.title: The Giants (Inferno, Canto XXXI)
artworks.description: Doré's Inferno giants: Ephialtes chained among the Titans who heaped Pelion on Ossa — the Aloadae's assault on heaven carried into Dante's pit.

popCulture.title: Otus and Ephialtes
popCulture.description: The giant twins who stack mountains to storm Olympus — and die by Artemis' stag between them.
